feeds.title: myTEFL Blog
feeds.description: Teach and travel the world with MyTEFL! We provide quality TEFL teacher training courses, volunteering experiences and paid internships.

feeds.title: Teacherhorizons
feeds.description: To transform the international school recruitment system by providing teachers with free and in depth information on international schools. Ultimately our aim is for more teachers to benefit from the opportunities and experience of teaching overseas

feeds.title: Rachel Meets China
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rachel! A twenty-something American living in China for 5 years.China has totally turned my world and perspective upside down. Life here is brilliant and bizarre and at times challenging, and it's filled with incredible travel adventures and the most amazing people. I love sharing about life in China and write posts all about teaching ESL in China, tips for living abroad, guides for traveling, special experiences and events in China, and also just day-to-day life here.

feeds.title: Teach English in China Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning provider of English teaching placements and homestays across China, offering placements in Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu and more. News, tips and information to help you discover what it's like to live like a local and teach English in China

feeds.title: Pioneer and Beyond Blog
feeds.description: Teach English in China with Pioneer & Beyond. Recruiting ESL teachers to relocate to China. No fee, no experience needed.

feeds.title: Hello Teacher! Blog
feeds.description: Teach English in China with us. Choose your city, school and hours. Teaching in China offers great benefits like good salary, free flight, apartment and more! Hello Teacher! is an Australia-based recruitment organization that specializes in placing English teachers all over China.

feeds.title: F&Y Consultant Ltd. Blog
feeds.description: If you are looking for jobs in China then you are at the right place. Teach-In-China.co.uk (F&Y Consultant Ltd. Recruitment) Blog Pages listing teaching in China Advice, Teacher accounts and News.

feeds.title: Goldstar TEFL Recruitement Blog
feeds.description: To maximise the quality of English language education throughout China for students of all ages, through the placement of exceptional English teachers in exceptional English schools.

feeds.title: ESL Authority | TEFL & ESL Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Quincy I'm the founder of ESL Authority. It was started as a resource for anyone interested in or currently teaching English abroad. As a former teacher, I've spent hours combing through outdated sites and know how hard it can be to find reliable information. When I started designing ESL Authority my main goal was simple - to make it user-friendly. I was tired of looking at sites that were difficult to navigate and filled with old or incomplete information. With this in mind, I set out to make a site that was above all informative, but also functional and relevant.

feeds.title: Let's TEFL Blog
feeds.description: Let's TEFL is an online TEFL certification company founded by a team of ESL teachers. We provide one simple 120-hour TEFL course which contains everything new ESL teachers need to know - in one concise package. Follow our blog to read stories and advice from TEFL teachers around the world.

feeds.title: Adventures Around Asia
feeds.description: My name is Richelle and I've been living in China and traveling around Asia for the last four years. Here's everything you would ever need to know about finding a job, managing a class and surviving culture shock.

feeds.title: The Working Traveller
feeds.description: To encourage people to travel longer by volunteering or picking up work abroad. On these pages we will post interesting articles and information on working, living and travelling abroad from our own sites and from across the web, mixed up with photos and things from our own travels.

feeds.title: China by Teaching Blog
feeds.description: We are hiring teachers to teach in China. Visit and Contact China By Teaching. We will use our unique insight to help you find a teaching job in China

feeds.title: The TEFL Blog
feeds.description: Chris has taught English in Ghana, South Korea and Vancouver to students from age 5 - 75. He was the Senior Academic Manager at King George International College for 5 years and the Program Coordinator of International Education at the University of Victoria.

feeds.title: China TEFLer
feeds.description: ChinaTEFLer.com is the revolutionary home to those interested in and those already out there Teaching English as a Foreign Language (TEFL) in China. Our Teaching English in China resources and educational material are constantly updated.

feeds.title: Oxford University Press
feeds.description: Welcome to Oxford University Press Blog. This blog is intended for teachers, trainers, lecturers, authors and anyone else with an interest in keeping up with what's happening in the world of ELT and what we're up to. We'll bring you resources you can use in your classrooms, hints and tips for teaching, insights into the lives of publishers and authors.

feeds.title: Sa-Recruitment Blog
feeds.description: We are a specialist teacher recruitment agency based in Cape Town, South Africa, recruiting teachers for contract teaching positions in the Middle East/Gulf States and China. TEFL jobs is part of the SA-Recruitment group and looks to assist graduates (with a degree) who wish to teach English in China.

feeds.title: JimmyESL Blog
feeds.description: One of the leading independent websites about teaching English abroad. Get practical advice about TEFL/TESL training and certification and working abroad. Find hundredes of teaching jobs on our job board.

feeds.title: ELT Experiences
feeds.description: I have been teaching EFL for nearly twelve years now, with teaching experience in South Korea, Romania as well as the UK. Currently, I am the Young Learner Co-ordinator at LTC Eastbourne. I am responsible for curriculum development as well as the training of current Young Learner teachers.

feeds.title: LanguageCorps
feeds.description: Our innovative programs empower you to create a personal adventure in teaching English abroad. You'll live in another culture, travel, and gain professional paid work experience.
